explanation: It is non-zero only at the GO step when the agent chooses a1 and the previous trial was rewarded; it is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at every a2 choice, and after an unrewarded trial. It is highest (about 10) on the first rewarded a1 trial after one or more unrewarded trials, then drops on each further consecutive rewarded a1 trial (about 8, 6, 4, then near 0), and it runs weaker early in the episode (about 3-5 before trial 50, versus 7-10 after trial 55).
